text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered -> token-aggregation-service high error rate + consumer lag spike. Pager: oncall. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/token-aggregation

ana (oncall): I'm on it. seeing consumer lag jump and the aggregator forwarder timing out. starting log collection and pod checks.

jacob (sre): I see a rebalance in the consumer group around the same time. offsets stalled. could be stuck long-processing messages. first guess: one of the forwarder instances hit a deadlock.

sam (eng-infra): FYI there was a config tweak in the streaming cluster last night (increase in commit interval). pulling metrics to correlate with consumer lag.

mira (billing): Heads up from the billing side: dashboard started firing overage flags for some customers who consumed during the window. We need scope ASAP — risk of incorrect invoicing if counts aren't reconciled.

ana (oncall): Quick status: queue depth: ~120k messages visible in token-agg topic. Affected window looks like ~23:10-23:35 UTC. Number of accounts with alerts: preliminary 12, top 3 account ids: acct_42, acct_817, acct_9001.

ana (oncall): Running pod checks now:
```
kubectl get pods -n billing | grep token-agg
token-agg-5f6d   2/3   CrashLoopBackOff   4     23h
token--b7a9      3/3   Running            1     23h
```

ana (oncall): tailing logs from the failing pod:
```
ERROR 2026-03-14T23:12:15Z consumer: message processing stalled for 00:04:23, offset 12345678
WARN  2026-03-14T23:12:23Z forwarder: batch flush timeout after 30s
ERROR 2026-03-14T23:13:05Z OutOfMemoryError while building batch
```

jacob (sre): That OOM in the batch builder explains the stall. Might be a memory regression in the new binary. Workaround: restart and force the instance to use fallback marshaller, then plan a rollback.

sam (eng-infra): Can do immediate restart, but if it's a binary regression we should scale down new version and bring up previous until we have a fix.

ana (oncall): Performing restart of the CrashLoopBackOff pod now and scaling down the suspect deployment to 1 replica while we verify.
```
kubectl rollout restart deployment/token-agg -n billing
kubectl scale deployment/token-agg -n billing --replicas=1
```

deploy-bot: Deployment token-agg restarted by ana at 23:18:13 UTC. Rollout in progress.

ana (oncall): Pods are coming up. health checks passing on the restarted replica. beginning to observe consumer lag reduce (120k -> 45k).

jacob (sre): Lag trending down after restart — looks like some messages are being processed. Recommend we let the backpressure drain and then run a safe backfill for the unprocessed window.

mira (billing): We need a repeatable reconciliation path. I'll prepare a backfill + reconciliation job to apply missing tokens into billing. Before we run it, we should suppress automated overage notifications so customers don't get charged or alerted twice.

lee (product-sre): I can mute the overage alerts for the billing dashboard for 30m and add a manual banner to the portal. Are we comfortable with a planned backfill and manual credits for anyone impacted?

mira (billing): Yes. Plan: 1) mute alerts; 2) run reconciliation for events between 2026-03-14T23:10:00Z and 2026-03-14T23:35:00Z; 3) produce account-level delta and apply credits where delta>0 and customer was flagged.

ana (oncall): Preparing a list of affected accounts (running query):
```
SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS pending_events
FROM token_events
WHERE processed_at IS NULL
  AND event_time BETWEEN '2026-03-14T23:10:00Z' AND '2026-03-14T23:35:00Z'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY pending_events DESC
LIMIT 100;
```

ana (oncall): Top results: acct_42 (29k tokens), acct_817 (12k), acct_9001 (9.5k), several others < 2k.

mira (billing): OK, I'll draft a customer note and queue credits for acct_42/817/9001 pending reconciliation results. Also informing CS to hold outreach until counts are verified.

ana (oncall): Starting reconciliation backfill job now (dry-run pass first):
```
python infra/tools/backfill_tokens.py --start 2026-03-14T23:10:00Z --end 2026-03-14T23:35:00Z --dry-run
```

ana (oncall): Dry-run looks good. Sample output: acct_42 delta=+28972, acct_817 delta=+12340, acct_9001 delta=+9520. No duplicate events detected in dry-run.

ana (oncall): Running actual backfill. Monitoring queue and write rate.

[job output]
```
2026-03-14T23:45:41Z backfill: writing 120k events -> billing_write_queue
2026-03-14T23:52:03Z backfill: 80% complete
2026-03-14T23:59:12Z backfill: complete, 119,874 events applied
```

mira (billing): Reconciliation applied. Confirming final counts now and will unmute alerts after verification. Will then apply credits to top three accounts and file a billing incident for audit.

jacob (sre): I'll keep monitoring consumer lag and the forwarder error count for the next hour. If anything flares, page me.

ana (oncall): Handoff: I need to go offline in 30m. Leaving notes in the incident channel and runbook. Key actions taken: restarted token-agg, scaled down suspect version, ran backfill for 23:10-23:35 UTC, muted overage alerts, applied temporary credits to top affected accounts (mira to confirm final amounts).

mira (billing): Confirmed credits queued for acct_42/817/9001. We'll reconcile final invoice adjustments in the monthly billing run and notify CS to reach out to affected customers with the final numbers.

lee (product-sre): Postmortem owners: eng-runtime + billing. Suggested next steps: add automated circuit-breaker to failforward instead of OOM, add canary traffic test for memory-heavy batches, and improve alerting to include raw queue depth + backlog time.

ana (oncall): Thanks team. Leaving in good state. Jacob will take post-incident monitoring.

jacob (sre): ack. I have dashboard alerts muted until 00:45 UTC, will unmute after confirming no regression and that backfill metrics are stable.

ana (oncall): Closing live mitigation. Will open a postmortem ticket and assign to eng-runtime for root cause and billing for customer fixes. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident P2 resolved -> mitigation complete. Notes: token-aggregation stall caused by OOM in batch builder (suspected regression). Backfill applied; credits queued. Follow-up: postmortem assigned.
